steps.content:
Short answer: **Neither — on the listings themselves, they are identical.**

I checked both URLs. Apart from the seller name, every material detail is the same:

|  | A: Brackmoor Sound | B: Ottervale Audio |
|---|---|---|
| Product | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones | *Same* |
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Stock | In stock | In stock |
| Shipping | Free standard, arrives in 3-5 business days | Free standard, arrives in 3-5 business days |
| Returns | 30-day returns, buyer pays return shipping, refund to original payment method | *Same* |
| Warranty | 1-year limited warranty | *Same* |
| Rating shown | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) |
| Specs / in the box | Over-ear, ANC + transparency, 40h battery, USB-C, Bluetooth 5.3, 254g, carry case + cables, graphite | *Same* |

There is no basis in these two pages to prefer one over the other — no price difference, faster shipping, better returns, longer warranty, or higher rating for either.

So pick whichever you prefer for reasons *outside* the listings, for example:
- a seller you've bought from before and had good service from
- independent reputation / reviews of the seller (not just this product rating) that you can verify elsewhere
- which payment method / buyer protection you're more comfortable using
- return address / taxes / delivery location if that matters to you

If you have no outside preference for either, it's essentially a coin flip — buying from A vs. B should, based on what's shown, get you the same product on the same terms.
